projTitle: CP Layer Hens for School Lunch Project
projSummary: Carrying forward a royal initiative, the project brings egg protein to school lunches in remote areas. Teachers and students raise the layers themselves, cook the eggs into lunch, and sell the surplus in their community as a revolving fund. Running continuously since 1989, now in its 37th year.
projFull1: The Foundation funds hen house construction and a full equipment set — cages, water lines, and feed troughs — plus pullets and feed across the full 60-week production cycle, with inputs and husbandry technique from specialists.
projFull2: Malnutrition in member schools has fallen steadily. Each school holds a revolving fund averaging THB 30,000, every flock cycle yields up to 26 million eggs, and the project has created work for more than 525 people with disabilities.
